title: 36 Hours in Zagreb, Croatia
abstract: While the Croatian capital’s vibe is indeed more Vienna than, say, Belgrade, it can also be deliciously rough-and-tumble.

title: 36 Hours in Zurich
abstract: Handsome beaches, bohemian design and youthful chaos await outside the popular Old Town.

title: 36 Hours in Cleveland
abstract: Local entrepreneurs and bohemian dreamers alike are sinking roots into this city by opening a wave of funky boutiques and sophisticated restaurants.

title: 36 Hours in Bermuda
abstract: Four hundred years ago, an English sailing vessel was shipwrecked on this mid-Atlantic archipelago, giving birth to an island nation that’s now in full-swing party mode.

title: 36 Hours in Baltimore
abstract: Crab joints and sports bars now share the cobblestone streets with fancy cafes and tapas restaurants.
